title: How are parts washed after mesh-belt oil quenching? De-oiling, detergent washing and air blow-off
summary: Suneng's mesh-belt heat-treatment line proposal uses initial air blow-off/de-oiling at the oil-tank elevator exit, followed by detergent washing, rinsing and blow-off before tempering. Separate carried-over quench oil, washing and residual cleaning liquid. A blower does not replace cleaning-performance inspection, and automatic water replenishment does not prove consistently acceptable cleaning-fluid condition.
